caption: The drawing depicts a white or light gray urn with a lid, rendered against a solid black rectangular background. The urn is decorated with two symmetrical, curved handles on either side and stands on a broad, round base with scalloped edges. The lid features a sculptural finial of a seated human figure with two raised arms, each hand holding or supporting an arched element above their head. The urn and the sculptural finial both display subtle shading in pale blue and violet hues, emphasizing their three-dimensional form and glossiness. In the lower right corner of the black background, there is a small white label with the text “STEWART” on it. The black rectangular area is bordered by a beige or tan area, which frames the composition.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
